product.name: Generic two-panel push-pull smart door lock
product.name_trap: Different brands reuse the same model names; always search brand plus model.

sources.confirms: interior and exterior bodies mount on opposite door faces; connection wire passes through the door bore
mortise cut to door thickness; exterior assembly seated on the outside face

purpose.job: Recognise the visitor and unlock without a key.

units.label: exterior lock panel
units.orientation: vertical, camera at the top facing the visitor, keypad below

units.label: interior lock panel
units.orientation: vertical, screen at the top, push-pull handle in the middle

constraints.rule: A closed door shows at most one panel in one view.
constraints.prompt: only one side of the closed door is visible
constraints.check: The two panels never appear on the same face of a door.

constraints.prompt: the camera module faces outward toward the corridor
constraints.check: Camera faces the corridor, not the home.

forbidden.text: both panels side by side on the same face of a door
forbidden.negative: two lock panels on the same side of the door

liberties.text: Divided split frame, outside and inside halves.
liberties.prompt: split-screen with a clear divider, outside view on one half, inside view on the other
